id: 1 apk10-go-to-board-no-empty-frame (pregame-found-countdown-reduced): empty frames between the count's GO! and the game route's GO! cover
deviceCheck:
Needs a new APK.
1) Reduced Motion off. Run 4 ranked games: 'שחק' → '2 שחקנים' → 'מהיר' → 'מצא יריב' against the hidden bot, with screenrecord. Check every frame from GO!'s first frame to the first board frame. Expected: no frame with only the ambient background, and GO!, the strip and the ghost board never dip toward 0. At the route switch, GO! stays put at full brightness; after it, only GoCover's own GO!→board cross-fade (~240 ms) shows.
2) Reduced Motion on, 2 games: no empty frame and no movement at the switch; GO!→board is a ~200 ms fade.
3) GO! first frame → first board frame stays about as in apk10 (~1.3 s, or ~1.0 s with Reduced Motion).
4) Tap a cell right after the board appears: it responds. Android back during GO! does nothing.
5) After the game, on Results tap 'לבית', and also leave a game via its own exit: never land on an old 'מחפש יריב' or GO! screen. Back stack check: in a game, surrender → Results → Android back goes Home.
6) logcat: no '[Reanimated]' failure burst about 20–600 ms after the board appears, when the covered match screen is dropped.

id: 2 results-search-gap (pregame-found-countdown-reduced): empty frames between Results 'משחק חדש' and the search
deviceCheck:
Needs a new APK.
1) Reduced Motion off. Finish a ranked game, then tap Results 'משחק חדש' with screenrecord, 3 times. Expected: no ambient-only frame between the results and 'מחפש יריב…'; at most a normal cross-fade dip.
2) While searching, Android back (cancel) goes where it went before: the game type screen or Home, not the old results. Do 'משחק חדש' 3 times in a row, then back out step by step: no old results ever show.
3) Practice: Results 'משחק חדש' → the new board fades in over the results, with no empty frames.
4) Reduced Motion on: the same, with the shorter fade.
5) 'לבית', and Android back on Results, still go Home.

id: 3 pregame-found-sound / apk10-sounds-first-ranked: first ui_tap after a cold start and first cell_select of the first game are silent
deviceCheck:
Needs a new APK. Media volume up (phone 3 had media volume 0), sound on.
1) Force-stop, launch, wait ~3 s on Home, then tap 'שחק'. In `adb shell dumpsys audio` (PlaybackActivityMonitor, the app's uid), expect one muted ui_tap event:started from the warm-up ~1–2 s after Home showed. Then a new event:started at the 'שחק' tap, heard as a soft click.
2) Continue '2 שחקנים' → 'מהיר' → 'מצא יריב'. A burst of muted warm-up starts is expected. matchFound, the 3 beats and GO are heard whole, with their attack not clipped.
3) In this first game, tap a cell: cell_select is heard (event:started at the tap). The first correct digit is heard.
4) A solo practice, and a staged level, right after a cold start: the first cell tap is heard.
5) NEW: on Home, press the Home button within ~1 s of launch (before the warm-up), wait 5 s, come back and tap 'שחק': the tap is heard. The same for a game: press Home while the board is coming in, return, and tap a cell: heard.
6) Sound off in Settings: nothing is heard anywhere.

id: interference-picker-grid-small (2P header at 320-360 dp, apk10-2p-header-360dp)
deviceCheck: Phone 3 (SM-A165F), font size 1.0. A) wm density 540 (320 dp), app in English, ranked 2P (the hidden bot is fine). 1) My card: instead of 'No mistakes' it shows a small boxed-X mark and '0' in the big condensed digits. No word is broken ('No mi / stakes' is gone) and nothing is tiny. 2) Make one mistake: the number becomes '1', briefly red, with a small pop (with Remove animations on: red only, no pop). 3) Opponent card: the interfere button is only the lightning icon in a 44-dp square, with no 'Interfere' word and no tiny text. TalkBack, or the content-desc in a ui dump, reads 'Interfere with <name> · costs N pts'. A tap opens the picker as before. 4) The VS badge sits in the gap between the cards and covers neither flag nor my rating. Names may end in '…' a little sooner. B) Same density in German, Russian, Italian and Hebrew: the button is icon-only in all of them. My mistakes: de 'Keine / Fehler' and he 'אין / טעויות' in two full-size lines, ru as mark + number, it as mark + number. Nothing breaks inside a word. C) Normal density (physical 450): in Hebrew the button reads 'הפרעה' at full size (not shrunk) and 'אין טעויות' is two full-size lines. In English the button is icon-only and 'No / mistakes' is two full-size lines. VS does not touch either flag (it may sit very close at about 2 dp). D) Optional, nl or tr at density 540, under an interference (opponent paused): 'Pauze · A8' / 'Durdu · A8' with no mid-word break. Reset the density afterwards.

id: appBug 6 / account-settings-licenses-expand
deviceCheck: 1. Set the interface to Hebrew. 2. Home, then the settings button, then 'רישיונות'. 3. Tap 'SIL Open Font License 1.1' under 'גופנים'. Expected: the text runs left to right and is left-aligned. Each paragraph fills the full width with no one- or two-word lines mid-paragraph (e.g. the PREAMBLE paragraph runs continuously from 'The goals of the Open Font License...' to 'with others.'). The dashed lines, the title 'SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE Version 1.1 - 26 February 2007', and the headings PREAMBLE / DEFINITIONS / PERMISSION & CONDITIONS / TERMINATION / DISCLAIMER each stay on their own line. Clauses 1) to 5) each start on a new line. 4. Tap again: the text closes. 5. Scroll to 'נוסחי הרישיונות' and tap MIT. Expected: 'MIT License' on its own line, then 'Permission is hereby granted, ... to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal...' as one continuous paragraph (no 'person obtaining' / 'a copy' break and no '(the' / '"Software"' break). 6. Open BSD-3-Clause: each '*' bullet starts its own line. Open Apache-2.0: the numbered sections 1. to 9. and (a) to (d) each start on their own line, with no ragged lines inside them.
